# names(pattern) lists what a file: directory holds at build time, as a
# list<string> of the matching names, sorted. It is how a program hands a
# directory's contents to a pure function as an argument rather than the
# function reading the directory while it runs -- which nothing records, and
# which a stored result would therefore replay after the directory changed.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
grep '(?s)<span>one.png</span>\s*<span>two.png</span>' out/index.html
! grep 'notes.txt' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import shots "file:shots"

const pngs = shots.names("*.png")

window(title="shots") {
	for var n = pngs {
		text(value=n)
	}
}
-- shots/two.png --
two
-- shots/one.png --
one
-- shots/notes.txt --
notes
